briefs.claim_en: India's Chandrayaan-3 mission successfully landed near the Moon's south pole, making it the first country to achieve a landing in that region.
briefs.brief_en: NASA and Space.com report that India's Chandrayaan-3 mission successfully landed near the Moon's south pole on August 23, 2023, making India the first country to achieve a landing in that region. DD India also reported this historic landing on August 23, 2023. Al Jazeera reported on August 23, 2023, that India could become the first nation to land a spacecraft on the Moon's south pole. Several fact-checking organizations (BOOM Fact Check, Alt News, AFP Fact Check, India Today, The Quint, Telugu Post) have rated as false various claims related to fake footage or images of the Chandrayaan-3 landing.

briefs.claim_en: The Vikram lander of the Chandrayaan-3 mission successfully touched down at 18:04 local time (12:34 GMT).
briefs.brief_en: NDTV reported on August 23, 2023, that the Vikram lander touched down at 6:04 PM local time on Wednesday, August 23. BBC News also reported on August 23, 2023, that the Vikram lander successfully touched down as planned at 18:04 local time (12:34 GMT). Space.com, in an article published August 22, 2023, anticipated the touchdown at 6:04 p.m. in India (1:34 p.m. GMT). Al Jazeera reported on August 23, 2023, that the landing was scheduled shortly after 6 PM India time (12:30 GMT). BOOM Fact Check and FACTLY have rated as false claims that certain videos show the Chandrayaan-3's Vikram lander landing on the Moon's south pole.
